method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: Connecting to the user's own Notion workspace (Notion sign-in/authorization, or a connection token)

evidence.quote:
Start the Notion connection process by clicking the **Connect to Notion**
   button in the Notero preferences.

Notero is a [Zotero plugin](https://www.zotero.org/support/plugins) for syncing
items and notes into [Notion]

checkNote: README "Connect to Notion" section says to start the Notion connection, and the default notionDatabaseID is empty. The code stores logins via Services.logins and calls api.notion.com, so a Notion connection is needed before anything syncs. There are no AI features.
